caption: Figure 2: Quicksand places resource proclets where they are avail- able: e.g., memory proclets (blue) on machine 1 with available RAM; and compute proclets (orange) on machine 2 with spare CPU. Quick- sand splits, merges, and migrates resource proclets as they grow, shrink, and as resource pressure

templates.why_chosen: Two machine panels share one inside legend (blue/orange/gray proclet types) at the top, with per-machine CPU/RAM bars and a warning icon making the resource-pressure asymmetry that motivates the arrows immediately visible.
templates.what_to_learn: Put one shared legend above both panels, not one per panel, then reuse its colours in a small utilization-bar readout under each panel; mark the trigger condition (a red warning triangle on the strained resource) so the dashed migrate/split/merge arrows have a visible cause.
